description: Pack picked units into a package on a ship list, or take them out — the packing screen. Each line names a ship list line (lineId, or the SKU) and a quantity in the line's unit; lot-, expiry- and serial-tracked lines name which picked lots, expiries or serials go in (optional when only one choice fits). Lines go into a new package unless packageNumber names an existing one; package sets the box (container from list_shipping_containers, or dimensions), weight, shipping method, tracking number and cost — on an existing package only the fields given change. action=unpack takes a line out of the named package (omit quantity to take it all out). A list not started yet is started first (shipper defaults to you). Two-step: preview=true, then commit with the previewReceipt. Then ship_out ships the fully packed list.

clientId.description: Optional client id (GUID) for operator (unpinned) credentials on 3PL tenants.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

lines.description: Lines to pack or unpack (max 100). All lines commit together or not at all.

action.description: pack (default) puts units in the package; unpack takes units out of the package.

expiries.description: Expiry dates and their units, for date-tracked items (pack only). Optional when one picked expiry covers the quantity.

lineId.description: Ship list line id (GUID) from get_ship_list. Either lineId or sku is required.

lots.description: Lots and their units, for lot-tracked items (pack only). Optional when one picked lot covers the quantity.

quantity.description: Units to pack or unpack, in the line's unit of measure (> 0). For unpack, omit to empty the line out of the package.

serials.description: Serial numbers, for serial-tracked items (pack only, one per unit). Optional when exactly that many picked serials remain unpacked.

sku.description: Item SKU on the ship list; must match exactly one line.

package.description: Box, weight, shipping method and tracking for the package.

container.description: Shipping container (box) name or id from list_shipping_containers; fills the dimensions and max weight.

dimensionUnit.description: Dimension unit name or abbreviation (e.g. in, cm). Defaults to the container's.

shippingMethod.description: Shipping method name or id from list_shipping_methods.

weight.description: Packed weight, in the weight unit.

weightUnit.description: Weight unit name or abbreviation (e.g. lb, kg). Defaults to the container's.

packageNumber.description: Existing package number (from get_ship_list) to pack into or unpack from. Omit to pack into a new package.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing is written until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit.

shipListId.description: Ship list id (GUID) or number from list_ship_lists.

shipper.description: Shipper (team member email or user id) when this call starts the list. Defaults to you.

name: pack_items
title: Pack Items
